notes.title: 2024.09.11 Game Update Notice
notes.notes:
[b]New Features Added in This Update[/b]
Underwater Exploration (Event)
Lieutenant
Missile Silo
Season

[b]Optimizations in This Update[/b]
·2 new scenes added to the shooting mini-game, new texture for the medical ship, fighter jets replaced with helicopters
·New mechanism for the first login bonus when creating a character within 15 days of the first login
·New package for building queue
·New package for city skin
·New section for daily must-buy discounts
·Resource Month Card increased privileges: 25% increase in base resource production
·Growth Fund changed to cash purchase
·Content of the super value discount package adjusted
·Translation function added to private messages and faction mail
·Newbie mini-game changed to a chain of 5 games, before entering the mission
·Equipment modification tasks are guided in the modification interface
·Chat removed the level limit (above level 25)
·Private message removed diamond consumption
·Font colors of missiles and fighters modified
·Month card display optimized
·Mini-game changed to turrets and helicopters
·Iron Curtain ranking logic optimized
·World Progress first stage completed second stage tasks, and the first stage ends directly to the third stage
·Deleted data for faction chests, no longer stored
·Adjusted the tasks, rewards, and duration of the World Progress
·The Brave Trial activity changed to be open every week
·Warship quality modified to white n, green nr, blue r, purple s, orange sr, red ssr, and color sp, with borders added
·The first login warship changed to red ssr
·Modified the placement of warship construction tokens in the chapter task
·A warship construction token package was added to the limited-time package
·The animation when opening the equipment wheel interface was removed
·The rule for the pop-up window when exiting and re-entering the game was changed to 15 days
·The submarine did not have a periscope and could not be zoomed in
·The recoil force in the Iron Curtain battle was increased
·Submarines and warships gained active attacks
·Chapter 3, Level 1: Increase the sound effects of attacking enemy warships in the Noah's Ark. Enemies take proportional damage.
·The Officer Pack has been changed to trigger when the first officer is deployed back to the main base.
·The "Activity" button on the main interface has been hidden, and the first two buttons can be collected.
